citations.quote:
[name="斯乔帕"]……那我也还有……最后一个要求。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#1$3",focus="l")]
[name="叶甫根尼"]哦？你现在还能用什么和我提要求？
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#2$3",focus="r")]
[name="斯乔帕"]凭“利沃诺夫号”是现在第四集团军中离泽尔格勒最近的单位。
[name="斯乔帕"]你知道我有得选，我可以选择直接“帮助”你和第一集团军开战，鳞死网破，两败俱伤。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#2$3",focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true)]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "avg_npc_2236_1#2$1", duration = 0)]
[name="叶甫根尼"]你宁愿和西尔卡少尉到下面去重逢也不愿就这样认命吗？真是感人。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#7$3",focus="r")]
[name="斯乔帕"]那就让我再听一次她的声音。
[name="斯乔帕"]最后一次——
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#7$3",focus="r")]
[name="斯乔帕"]在这之后，“谢钦”会一切按照你的计划行事，如你所愿。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#7$3",focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true)]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "avg_npc_2236_1#3$1", duration = 0)]
[name="叶甫根尼"]……
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "avg_npc_2236_1#1$1", duration = 0)]
[name="叶甫根尼"]把她带过来。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#2$3",focus="r")]
[name="斯乔帕"]感谢你的仁慈，总司令阁下。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#2$3",focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true)]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "char_empty", duration = 0)]
[delay(time=1)]
[name="冷淡的声音"]……斯乔帕——
[Dialog]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
一模一样的声音。和无数次在断续的通讯中向他汇报情况时一样的声音。
并不像是在身边时、在对面交谈时听到的那样，而只是在战场上，在训练中，在一切难以仔细辨认情绪的紧迫情况中——
都一样平静而冷淡的声音。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#4$3",focus="r")]
[name="斯乔帕"]……西尔卡，我会找到你。
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#4$3",focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true)]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "char_empty", duration = 0)]
[name="冷淡的声音"]不要——不，斯乔帕，不要为了我。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_4226_veen_1#4$3",focus="r")]
[name="斯乔帕"]不仅是为了你。我不会再让任何战友只因为得了矿石病就不得不被驱逐。
[name="斯乔帕"]我要把你们所有人都找回来。

contributions.description: 维伊与西尔卡有多次既往通讯，当前再次听到其声音。

directions.reason: 双方直接对话、明确共同参与，或有具体既往互动。
